title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE missing outbuf_cap field
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info exposes outbuf_pending (unread bytes) but not outbuf_cap (total buffer capacity). A debugger cannot observe how close the session is to the CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_MAX ceiling or distinguish 'buffer full' from 'provider slow'. Adding outbuf_cap later consumes one of the _pad bytes, which is fine, but the current omission means any debugger relying on GET_STATE today cannot diagnose back-pressure conditions. Low severity: outbuf_pending is the operationally useful field; cap is diagnostic-only.
close_reason: Correct design: GET_STATE ioctl intentionally does not expose outbuf_cap — that is an internal kernel buffer management detail not relevant to userspace. Exposing it would create ABI surface for no functional benefit. Callers need outbuf_len (available data), not capacity.
